nodes.name: Record the delivery acknowledgement
Workflow overview and setup

parameters.content:
## Create consent-aware birthday and anniversary greetings with annual tracking

### How it works
Select a due, approved celebration with greeting consent. Treat birthdays and anniversaries separately, apply an explicit leap-day policy, and reveal birthday age only when ShowAge is true. One video runs at a time; annual keys prevent duplicates and the result includes a private delivery handoff. A separate recovery log skips completed keys and resumes accepted jobs. Review the video and CSV before sharing. Optional approved email delivery is off by default.

### Setup
1. Install **`@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid`** from **Settings → Community nodes** before credentials. A workspace owner/admin may need to install it.
2. Create a **Zvid API** credential with [your key](https://app.zvid.io/api-keys) and Base URL `https://api.zvid.io`; select it on all Zvid nodes.
3. Connect Google Sheets and select the **Celebration Runs** log tab. Create RenderKey, Status, JobId, CreditsQuoted, PlanJson, VideoUrl and CompletedAt headers; optional delivery also needs DeliveryStatus.
4. Configure CelebrationKey, Name, Type, Date, Approval, GreetingConsent; optional DoNotContact, Email, EmailApproval, ShowAge and Message. See the [source contract and migration guide](https://github.com/Zvid-io/zvid-n8n/blob/master/workflows/birthday-greetings.md).
5. **dryRun=false spends credits.** true returns JSON and a quote only. Set maxCreditsPerVideo, then test manually before enabling the schedule.
6. Avoid overlapping executions. Inspect submitting, failed or uncertain jobs before resetting any log row.

### Customization
Adjust branding and the domain rules in **Set celebration consent and delivery rules**. Watch downloads time out after 30 seconds; the saved URL remains available.

nodes.name: 1. Choose source rules and schedule

parameters.content:
## 1. Choose source rules and schedule

manualDemo=true creates a fresh fictional greeting on each manual execution and spends credits when dryRun=false. Email stays unavailable for demos. Disable manualDemo for the real contact queue. Run one execution at a time.

nodes.name: 2. Check the real source and plan the output

parameters.content:
## 2. Check the real source and plan the output

Give each occasion a permanent CelebrationKey. Older sheets need Approval and GreetingConsent columns; never infer either. Preserve LastSentYear and Celebration Runs. Respect DoNotContact, leap-day rules and birthday age opt-in. Process one due celebration per run; inspect skipped reasons otherwise.

nodes.name: 3. Recover accepted work before a new render

parameters.content:
## 3. Recover accepted work before a new render

Saved jobs follow the upper route using their original review context. New work continues through optional media and the domain design.

nodes.name: 4. Check optional background music

parameters.content:
## 4. Check optional background music

A failed or oversized music file is skipped. Empty musicUrl continues without an external request. This check preserves the selected source plan.

nodes.name: 5. Compose the approved celebration

parameters.content:
## 5. Compose the approved celebration

Branch between birthdays and anniversaries. Use only the approved occasion facts, respect age opt-in, and add the personal message to the greeting.

nodes.name: 6. Build and validate the design and credit ceiling

parameters.content:
## 6. Build and validate the design and credit ceiling

dryRun=true returns the source plan, design JSON and quote. It performs no log writes, editor draft creation, render, or delivery.

nodes.name: 7. Reserve the key and preserve the accepted job

parameters.content:
## 7. Reserve the key and preserve the accepted job

Save the key and accepted job ID. Retry explicit capacity rejections up to three attempts, respecting the server delay and a 30-second minimum. Uncertain submissions require inspection. Sheets is not an atomic lock.

nodes.name: 8. Wait for the accepted render and record its result

parameters.content:
## 8. Wait for the accepted render and record its result

Read the recovery log once per execution. Set replayRenderKey to a completed key for playback without new renders, sheet writes or email. Clear it for the normal queue. Keep failed or uncertain jobs for inspection.

nodes.name: 9. Review the video and source-specific handoff

parameters.content:
## 9. Review the video and source-specific handoff

Completed renders reach Watch video → Binary → data → View. A failed render stops with its actual reason after saving the tracking row. Download the review CSV and check source facts before sharing. Optional delivery is off by default.

nodes.name: 10. Deliver only when explicitly enabled

parameters.content:
## 10. Deliver only when explicitly enabled

Optional delivery is off by default. Greeting emails also require EmailApproval=approved. Record sending before delivery and retain the acknowledgement. Inspect uncertain sends manually; completed runs never resend automatically.
